lead.en: Illustrate token routing across sparse experts using host-supplied scores.
lead.zh: 用宿主提供的分数展示 token 在稀疏专家间的路由。

rule.en: The host supplies scores and optional parameter counts; no model is executed. Positive finite scores are ranked with stable tie order. Capacity controls skipped choices. Unspecified or invalid scores do not fabricate a route.
rule.zh: 分数和可选参数量由宿主提供，组件不执行模型。正数且有限的分数按高低排序，同分保持专家顺序；容量限制会跳过已满专家。缺失或无效分数不会生成虚构路由。

api.en: set_data replaces the illustration; set_top_k changes the number of choices, set_paused and set_visible control playback. MoeEvent reports routes and changes. Token and expert buttons support Enter, Space, arrows, Home, End and Escape.
api.zh: set_data 更新数据，set_top_k 切换选择数量，set_paused 和 set_visible 控制播放；MoeEvent 报告路由与切换。token 和专家按钮支持 Enter、空格、方向键、Home、End 和 Escape。

motion.en: The sample uses a moving packet along curved links. The stage switches to a vertical layout below 568 px. Hidden, paused and pinned views stop animation; reduced motion renders static links. Live announcements and desktop, Web, visual and accessibility verification remain pending.
motion.zh: 示例沿曲线移动数据标记，宽度小于 568px 时改为纵向排列。隐藏、暂停或固定时动画停止，减少动效时显示静态路径。状态播报、桌面、网页、视觉与无障碍实测仍待完成。
